execution: actual signed-in Codex CLI; online inference
workflow: Explore → proposals → simulated human selection → closer evidence with user correction → completion

scene.description: Paved surface with a white marking and a long dark linear opening or sealed joint, with vegetation at several points.

result.guidance: Move closer and frame a short section of the dark line and both adjoining surfaces, keeping the camera perpendicular and your shadow clear.
result.reason: Focus and exposure appear adequate for an overview, but the line could be a joint or a crack. A closer view and human review are needed; its width and any level difference cannot be measured from this photograph.

suggestions.title: Visible cracks / joints
suggestions.reason: Proposed check of the line's edges and continuity to help document a possible crack or joint. Experimental model observations require human confirmation.

suggestions.title: Periodic inspection, maintenance and defect follow-up
suggestions.reason: Proposed manual review of vegetation and the line's condition; physically measure opening width and any level difference, then compare with earlier maintenance records.

actions.instruction: Capture one closer, perpendicular view of the dark line with both adjoining surfaces visible and your shadow clear.

Proposed for your confirmation: have an inspector distinguish a formed or sealed joint from a crack using close inspection and available paving details; physically measure the opening and any level difference with suitable gauges.

scene.description: Close view of paving with a mostly straight dark line, irregular edges and vegetation in parts of the opening; joint versus crack remains uncertain.

result.guidance: For your selected cracks / joints check, capture one perpendicular close-up of an unobstructed section with a millimetre ruler beside the line, keeping both edges in focus.
result.reason: The image and supplied quality metrics suggest adequate focus and exposure, so refocusing is not the priority. Straight alignment may indicate a construction joint, but irregular edges do not establish a crack. Human review and physical measurements are needed to distinguish these possibilities and record its condition.

suggestions.title: Periodic inspection, maintenance and defect follow-up
suggestions.reason: Optional proposal awaiting your tap: document vegetation and edge condition, then compare physical measurements and dated photographs with maintenance records to assess changes.

actions.instruction: Capture one perpendicular close-up of a vegetation-free section with a millimetre ruler beside the opening in the same surface plane and both edges sharply visible.

Proposed for your confirmation: have an inspector compare the line with paving joint details and inspect its edges for evidence of a formed or sealed joint versus a crack. Physically measure opening width with a suitable gauge and any level difference with a straightedge and gauge; record locations and values without estimating them from this image.
